findings.event: August 2026 US Personal Income and Outlays / PCE
findings.comparison: The revised brief correctly gives the date but leaves the exact release time unconfirmed because the frozen edition did not contain this official calendar original. Do not backfill the post-cutoff check into that edition.

collector_gap: The September BLS monthly page visibly includes the October 2 employment release, so the current-month URL alone does not explain this edition's missing official calendar. A local production-style fetch of that BLS page returned HTTP 403; Fed, BEA and BOK pages succeeded. The installed worker host also returned HTTP 403 with the collector's User-Agent. Cross-month coverage and the 3,000-character excerpt cannot be qualified from an inaccessible original; official BLS schedule coverage remains unavailable through this route.
scope: External verification after the saved cutoff, not a replacement for point-in-time source collection or a passing editorial review.
